b2-40-verben-mit-praepositionen.intro: A giraffe has escaped its enclosure at the zoo, and Doreen can't stop thinking about it while Timo hopes for a quick return — every verb here paired permanently with one preposition: sich ärgern über, hoffen auf, sich kümmern um.

b2-41-nomen-mit-praepositionen.lastLine: ich froh , dass wir heute nur Besucher sind .
b2-41-nomen-mit-praepositionen.intro: Visiting an old palace, Merit's interest in the king's history runs deep, though Timo admits the throne itself would frighten him — every noun here paired with its own fixed preposition: Interesse an, Einfluss auf, Verantwortung für.

b2-42-adjektive-mit-praepositionen.lastLine: auch . Sie ist bekannt für ihre Kreativität .
b2-42-adjektive-mit-praepositionen.intro: At a gallery opening, Kerstin is proud of the artist and Timo is curious about the next exhibition — every judgment locked to its adjective's one true preposition: stolz auf, interessiert an, zufrieden mit.

b2-44-zustandspassiv.intro: Before a conference, Merle tells Timo the study is finally finished, the data evaluated, the research team informed — every sentence describing a completed state with sein + Partizip II, not the action that led there.

b2-45-passiversatz-sich-lassen.lastLine: ch bin froh , dass sich das behandeln lässt .
b2-45-passiversatz-sich-lassen.intro: At the doctor's, Timo asks whether his symptom can be treated and his blood value checked today — Frau Behrens answers every time with the natural alternative to kann … werden: das lässt sich behandeln, das lässt sich sofort machen.

b2-46-unpersoenliches-passiv.lastLine: Das klingt nach einer lebhaften Atmosphäre !
b2-46-unpersoenliches-passiv.intro: Touring a lively trade fair, Frauke and Timo notice how much discussing, laughing, and presenting is going on at every stand — a passive with no subject at all, just the action itself: hier wird diskutiert, hier wird fotografiert.

b2-47-bekommen-kriegen-passiv.lastLine: Perfekt ! Dann sind wir beide gut betreut .
b2-47-bekommen-kriegen-passiv.intro: Wenke gets her form filled out by the doctor and her results explained clearly, while Timo gets his appointment confirmed — every sentence built around the receiver, not the action, with bekommen/kriegen/erhalten + Partizip II.

b2-48-modalitaetsersatz-haben-sein-zu.lastLine: iel zu organisieren , aber wir schaffen das .
b2-48-modalitaetsersatz-haben-sein-zu.intro: Planning a hike, Britta has the route to plan and their travel time to keep to precisely, while Timo notes the weather can't quite be predicted — swapping müssen for the more formal haben + zu and sein + zu.

b2-49-passiv-in-wissenschaft-und-beruf.lastLine: kann der Bericht bald veröffentlicht werden .
b2-49-passiv-in-wissenschaft-und-beruf.intro: Antje and Timo prepare a research presentation and internship report side by side, moving fluidly through every passive structure they know — the experiment being carried out now, the results soon to be published.

b2-50-nominalisierung.lastLine: e Verbesserung der Situation freut uns alle .
b2-50-nominalisierung.intro: In a seminar, Katja and Timo turn everyday complaints — rising rents, a problem that took weeks to pin down — into the formal nouns German prefers: die Erhöhung der Mietkosten, die Untersuchung der Ursache.

b2-51-erweiterte-partizipialattribute.lastLine: banden gesammelten Daten sind sehr wertvoll .
b2-51-erweiterte-partizipialattribute.intro: In a sleep laboratory, Marret and Timo describe a participant sleepless for three nights and data collected carefully by the team — every relative clause compressed into a compact participial phrase set right before the noun.

b2-52-komplexe-nominalgruppen.lastLine: Ja , ich freue mich auf den Vortrag .
b2-52-komplexe-nominalgruppen.intro: A Nobel-laureate's visit next week has Runa and Timo excited — the theory developed by him, esteemed by so many researchers, changes how they see the world — every description layering adjectives, participles and genitives around one head noun.

b2-53-goethe-mini-4.lastLine: n uns vorbereiteten Notizen helfen mir sehr .
b2-53-goethe-mini-4.intro: The night before the B2 checkpoint, Nadine has her documents prepared and Timo still has questions explained by his teacher — moving fluidly from Zustandspassiv all the way to complex noun groups, one last time.

b2-54-funktionsverbgefuege.lastLine: Das bringt uns viel Erfolg in der Debatte .
b2-54-funktionsverbgefuege.intro: Before a meeting, Karla takes consideration of Timo's arguments and he puts his trust in the discussion ahead — every plain verb swapped for the formal noun + light-verb construction German prefers: eine Entscheidung treffen, Rücksicht nehmen.

b2-55-modalpartikeln-doch-ja.lastLine: Na siehst du , sie sind ja in der Jacke !
b2-55-modalpartikeln-doch-ja.intro: Ines can't find her keys, and Timo is sure they're on the table — they're indeed not there — until he suggests the jacket and, well, there they indeed are. doch and ja carry all the extra feeling the plain facts can't.

b2-56-modalpartikeln-eben-halt.lastLine: Genau ! Das ist eben der richtige Plan .
b2-56-modalpartikeln-eben-halt.intro: Nike is disappointed after a national-team loss and a nervous personal setback, and Timo shrugs it off with her — that's just how it goes, halt, eben — the two little words native speakers use to simply accept reality.

b2-57-textkohaerenz-verweiswoerter.intro: Meret shows Timo a summary she's written — one paragraph about the topic, in it an explanation; the next about the solution, this one — replacing repeated nouns with clear, natural reference words.

b2-58-textkohaerenz-absatzlogik.lastLine: n , deine Absätze folgen einer klaren Logik .
b2-58-textkohaerenz-absatzlogik.intro: Anke needs feedback on her cover letter, and Timo walks her through the logic — introduce yourself, justify your motivation, then summarize — one paragraph, one idea, in a clear order.

b2-59-konjunktiv-i-formen.intro: Reading a newspaper quote from a coach about an exciting kart race, Ida and Timo notice the verb forms look slightly off — ist becomes sei — the foundation for reported speech next chapter.

b2-60-indirekte-rede-grundlagen.lastLine: Gut , dann fragen wir ihn später .
b2-60-indirekte-rede-grundlagen.intro: Over the morning paper, Petra reports what her brother said about a tennis pro's win, and Timo notices neither of them is claiming it's true — every reported statement carried neutrally by Konjunktiv I.

b2-61-indirekte-rede-zeitverschiebung.lastLine: Danke ! Der Kunde wird erleichtert sein .
b2-61-indirekte-rede-zeitverschiebung.intro: A customer told Marlen the waiting time was too long and the package never arrived, and Timo promises to sort it out with shipping — every reported statement keeping the original timeline exactly, however far back it happened.
b2-61-indirekte-rede-zeitverschiebung.scene: Nachrichten von gestern, heute und morgen

b2-62-konjunktiv-i-berichtende-sprache.intro: For a university media project, Silke and Timo compare how different outlets report a schedule change — the reason said to be financial, citizens said to be dissatisfied — reporting neutrally, source by source, with never their own opinion mixed in.

b2-63-goethe-mini-5.intro: Preparing for the Goethe B2 exam, Yara takes consideration of Timo's schedule and reports what a colleague said about an appointment being too early — moving fluidly between Funktionsverbgefüge, Modalpartikeln, text cohesion, and Konjunktiv I.

b2-64-praepositionen-mit-genitiv.lastLine: Ich freue mich auf die Sitzung .
b2-64-praepositionen-mit-genitiv.intro: Preparing a formal university report, Wenke and Timo read official documents dense with Genitiv prepositions — due to the occasion, regarding the agenda, in favor of the project — the register of newspapers, contracts, and academic writing.

b2-65-wissenschaftssprache.lastLine: Genau ! Ich bin stolz auf unsere Arbeit .
b2-65-wissenschaftssprache.intro: Frauke and Timo prepare a university research presentation, replacing every "I think" with objective, evidence-based academic German: die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass … Precise, and never personal.

b2-66-argumentieren-standpunkte.intro: Preparing for a Goethe B2 speaking exam on artificial intelligence in education, Katrin argues that remote work saves time, and Timo pushes back — opinion, reason, agreement, and polite disagreement, in careful order.

b2-67-argumentieren-gegenargumente.lastLine: Danke ! Ich finde den Kompromiss sinnvoll .
b2-67-argumentieren-gegenargumente.intro: Still preparing for the same Goethe B2 exam, Timo raises a counterargument about loneliness in remote work, and Katrin concedes the point before countering with regular meetings — a stronger argument built by addressing the other side fairly.

b2-68-redemittel-fuer-diskussionen.lastLine: h haben wir einen guten Kompromiss gefunden .
b2-68-redemittel-fuer-diskussionen.intro: In a full Goethe B2 discussion on whether universities should require AI tools, Timo and Katrin manage the whole exchange with fixed phrases — asking to interrupt, summarizing, clarifying — grammar builds the sentences, Redemittel make them sound natural.

b2-69-goethe-zertifikat-b2-final.intro: The night before their Goethe B2 exam, Katrin and Timo run a final review session — nervous about the four skills tomorrow, but confident they've prepared — recycling grammar, vocabulary, and every discussion strategy from the whole course.

c1-01-tempusgebrauch-stilistische-tempus.lastLine: Danke ! Deine Rückmeldung hilft mir sehr .
c1-01-tempusgebrauch-stilistische-tempus.intro: Preparing a university research presentation, Meret uses the historical present for her opening scene to create tension, and Timo wonders if the tense-shifting mid-article will confuse readers — discovering why native writers deliberately switch tenses for effect.

c1-02-raum-und-zeit-praezise-ausdruecken.lastLine: Einverstanden ! Dann sehen wir uns morgen .
c1-02-raum-und-zeit-praezise-ausdruecken.intro: Organizing a research trip across Germany, Grit needs Timo's answer immediately after the meeting, and he promises the report within the week — every plan pinned down with precise spatial and temporal expressions, not just "where" and "when".

c1-03-nebensaetze-sicher-beherrschen.lastLine: Danke ! Ich überarbeite das Kapitel gleich .
c1-03-nebensaetze-sicher-beherrschen.intro: Antje edits a joint university research paper with Timo, flagging his nested subordinate clauses as impressive but unclear — the fix isn't more conjunctions, but rebuilding the sentence's whole architecture.

c1-04-hauptsaetze-elegant-verbinden.lastLine: Dann präsentieren wir die Ergebnisse morgen .
c1-04-hauptsaetze-elegant-verbinden.intro: Revising an academic article before submitting it to their professor, Wenke and Timo replace repetitive sentence sequences describing their sustainability initiative with elegantly coordinated main clauses — moreover, beyond that, nevertheless.

c1-05-zweiteilige-satzverbindungen.intro: Discussing a job candidate before a conference presentation, Silke argues she convinces both professionally and personally, while Timo notes neither her experience nor her language skills quite suffice — every judgment built on a paired connector, never left half-finished.

c1-06-goethe-mini-1.intro: The night before their Goethe C1 exam, Nike and Timo revise together at the university library — her argumentation convincing but unclear in structure, his advice to practise out loud — naturally recycling tense choice, precision, subordinate clauses, and paired connectors.

c1-07-praepositionen-mit-genitiv.lastLine: Ich werde das mit meinem Anwalt besprechen .
c1-07-praepositionen-mit-genitiv.intro: Timo's application was rejected due to the noise, and Frau Bruns explains the construction regulations behind it — every objection and justification dressed in a formal Genitiv preposition: aufgrund, hinsichtlich, ungeachtet.

c1-08-anspruchsvolle-praepositionen.lastLine: inanzieller Mittel müssen wir leider warten .
c1-08-anspruchsvolle-praepositionen.intro: Refining a research proposal, Elke and Timo replace simple prepositions with sharper alternatives — in view of the results, with the help of new methods, with regard to the questions still open — each one a stylistic upgrade, not just a correct choice.

c1-09-adjektive-mit-praepositionalergaen.lastLine: Gut . Ich bin überzeugt von deinem Talent .
c1-09-adjektive-mit-praepositionalergaen.intro: Preparing internship applications, Marlen says she's interested in the new position and ready for the challenge, while Timo says he's convinced of her talent — every adjective here locked to one fixed preposition, learned as a single vocabulary item.
c1-09-adjektive-mit-praepositionalergaen.scene: Vorbereitung einer Bewerbung für ein Forschungspraktikum

c1-10-nomen-mit-praepositionalobjekt.lastLine: Das stimmt . Ich rufe ihn heute noch an .
c1-10-nomen-mit-praepositionalobjekt.intro: Revising a research proposal, Antje admits her fear of a difficult conversation and her interest in a solution, while Timo notes the difference between their views isn't so big — every noun-preposition pair replacing a wordier verb phrase.

c1-11-goethe-mini-2.intro: Finalizing a research proposal under time pressure, Frauke and Timo split the tasks — she'll handle collaboration, he'll revise the text — naturally recycling Genitiv and advanced prepositions, plus fixed adjective and noun complements.

c1-12-modalverben-praezise-verwenden.lastLine: Einverstanden . Ich rufe den Techniker an .
c1-12-modalverben-praezise-verwenden.intro: The printer's broken, and Kirsten and Timo debate why — must be broken, could be the paper — weighing exactly how much certainty, doubt, or caution each modal verb carries.

c1-13-vermutungen-mit-modalverben-ausdru.lastLine: könnte wirklich sein . Ich prüfe das gleich .
c1-13-vermutungen-mit-modalverben-ausdru.intro: Faulty sales figures have Sina suspecting a system error and Timo wondering about human error — every modal verb here reveals how confident the speaker is, not necessarily what's true.

c1-14-konjunktiv-ii-fuer-irreales-und-hy.lastLine: Das klingt nach einer weisen Erkenntnis .
c1-14-konjunktiv-ii-fuer-irreales-und-hy.intro: Uta imagines the life she might have had if she'd studied medicine, and Timo asks whether that would have been the better path — every wish, regret, and hypothesis asking the same question: what if reality were different?

c1-15-konjunktiv-i-und-indirekte-rede.intro: Grit reports back from a university conference Timo missed — the minister claims he's innocent, a source says he lied — carefully preserving Konjunktiv I so neither of them takes sides.

c1-16-aufforderung-empfehlung-und-handlu.intro: Organizing an international academic conference, Silje recommends the safety goggles before inspection and Timo checks the gloves — every instruction softened from a command into a diplomatic recommendation.

c1-17-goethe-halbzeit-test.lastLine: versichtlich , dass der Bericht gut ankommt .
c1-17-goethe-halbzeit-test.intro: Preparing for an international research conference, Meret shares her summary and Timo suggests revising the last paragraph — naturally recycling modal verbs, both Konjunktivs, and diplomatic recommendations without it feeling like a grammar lesson.

c1-18-adjektivdeklination-sicher-anwende.lastLine: Ich werde das dem Ausschuss vorlegen .
c1-18-adjektivdeklination-sicher-anwende.intro: Reviewing research papers before a conference, Ines and Timo build long academic noun phrases — an extensive project, a recognized professor's new solution approach — asking each time who already carries the grammatical information, and who the adjective must carry it for.
c1-18-adjektivdeklination-sicher-anwende.scene: Durchsicht von Forschungsarbeiten vor einer Konferenz

c1-19-steigerung-und-sprachliche-abstufu.lastLine: e es an . Es ist mit Abstand die beste Wahl .
c1-19-steigerung-und-sprachliche-abstufu.intro: Before applying for scholarships, Solveig and Timo compare a renowned firm's offer against her old position — a considerably better career chance, a comparatively high salary — comparing ideas and evidence, not just adjectives.
c1-19-steigerung-und-sprachliche-abstufu.scene: Vergleich von Universitäten vor der Stipendienbewerbung

c1-20-relativsaetze-erweitern-und-variie.lastLine: t . Dann können wir das Projekt abschließen .
c1-20-relativsaetze-erweitern-und-variie.intro: Preparing a research article, Runa and Timo weigh whether a relative clause is the clearest way to reference a document or whether a compressed academic alternative reads better — organizing information, not just identifying nouns.

c1-21-partizipialattribute-verstehen-und.lastLine: Ich werde einen neuen Vorschlag vorbereiten .
c1-21-partizipialattribute-verstehen-und.intro: Before submitting to an international journal, Elke and Timo replace relative clauses about steadily sinking figures and a resigning CEO with compact participial attributes — folded relative clauses, nothing lost.
c1-21-partizipialattribute-verstehen-und.scene: Überarbeitung eines Artikels vor der Einreichung bei einer internationalen Fachzeitschrift

c1-22-komplexe-attribute-und-nominalgrup.lastLine: Gut , dann kürze ich den Absatz gleich .
c1-22-komplexe-attribute-und-nominalgrup.intro: Editing a research paper before submission, Britta and Timo condense an unclear thought from the last paragraph into a dense, sophisticated noun phrase — C1 sentences grow by enriching the noun, not by adding more clauses.
c1-22-komplexe-attribute-und-nominalgrup.scene: Überarbeitung eines Forschungsartikels vor der Einreichung
